description: Key figures from a company's latest annual accounts in Sweden (SE), Norway (NO) or the UK (GB): revenue, operating profit, net profit, total assets, equity, equity ratio, cash, liabilities and employees, with previous year, growth and margins. Costs $0.05 (USDC on Base, x402). Not charged if no machine-readable accounts exist. Small UK companies often file balance-sheet-only accounts.

country.description: Country of registration: SE (Sweden), NO (Norway), FI (Finland), GB/UK (United Kingdom). Default SE.

id.description: Company registry number: Swedish organisationsnummer (556632-2938), Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (923609016), Finnish Business ID (0112038-9) or UK Companies House number (00445790).

name: get_company_financials
title: Company financials (Sweden, Norway, UK)
